name: AXO Context Tools AI
author: tonytoubia

sections.description:
AXO uses the tag URL from your existing AXO site. It supports single-site WordPress installations. You can also let WordPress refresh zone flicker protection as you change which parts of the page AXO personalizes.

External service

Once an administrator enables AXO, visitors’ browsers load the tag from axoapp.ai or app.axoapp.ai. The tag requests configuration and variants from AXO and sends visitor activity used to measure and personalize the site according to the site’s AXO settings. This requires an AXO account. Configure your site’s notice and any required visitor consent before enabling the tag.

If an administrator enables automatic zone flicker protection, WordPress sends the site ID and a limited install token to axoapp.ai to retrieve zone selectors and the published tag version. WordPress sends those requests from the server during scheduled or manual refreshes. The token stays out of visitor pages.

Terms: https://axoapp.ai/terms
Privacy: https://axoapp.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and activate AXO.
  2. In AXO, open the site’s Install page and copy the Advanced script-only snippet. For a pinned tag, copy the tag URL from the recommended snippet’s src attribute.
  3. Remove any earlier AXO tag from your theme or tag manager.
  4. In WordPress, open Settings > AXO Context Tools AI, paste the snippet or URL, enable the tag, and save.
  5. To enable automatic zone flicker protection, copy the WordPress install token from your site’s AXO Install page. Paste it in Settings > AXO Context Tools AI, select Keep protection current automatically, and save. Use Refresh protection now to load the settings immediately.
  6. Purge the page cache and check the public page while signed out of WordPress.

Deactivate AXO to stop it adding the tag to new page responses. Purge the page cache after deactivating. Deleting the plugin removes its local settings.

If you installed the previous AXO Personalization ZIP, install and activate AXO Context Tools AI before deactivating or deleting the older plugin. This copies the saved settings. Then deactivate AXO Personalization and purge the page cache.
sections.faq:
What happens when WordPress cannot refresh zone protection?

The tag continues to run in Basic mode when WordPress has no current protection settings. Check Settings > AXO Context Tools AI to see whether WordPress has refreshed its settings, and check the AXO Install page for what visitors’ browsers report. Cached pages can take longer to reflect new settings. Purge the page cache when you need changes to appear immediately.

Can I use existing affiliate redirects?

WordPress keeps handling your redirects. Settings > AXO Context Tools AI lists eligible path prefixes from active Lasso Lite, Pretty Links and ThirstyAffiliates configurations. You can review those paths and add them to the affiliate click settings for your AXO site.
